core_principles: Charity First, Tech Second: The UI must feel like a premium tech product (SaaS) but all messaging and hero imagery must focus on human impact.
Zero Golf Clichés: No green/yellow combinations, no fairways, no plaid, no golf clubs.
High Contrast & Emotion: Use stark black/white structures with a vibrant, emotional 'Heartbeat Coral' as the sole accent color.
Motion & Momentum: Use smooth transitions and staggered reveal animations to make the data feel alive.

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Use MODE A (Tetris Grid) for marketing sections to create asymmetry. Use MODE B (Control Room Grid) for the Dashboard.
spacing_and_layout.generous_padding: Use p-8 to p-12 inside cards. Section padding should be py-24 to py-32 to let content breathe.
spacing_and_layout.container_alignment: Avoid center alignment for heavy text; prefer left-aligned blocks with tight left margins.

surface_strategies.marketing_cards: Glassmorphism: bg-zinc-900/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-2xl.
surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat Solid: bg-zinc-900 border border-white/5 rounded-xl. No heavy shadows, focus on clean data separation.
surface_strategies.buttons: Primary: Solid #F43F5E with hover brightness increase. Secondary: Transparent with #27272A border and white text.

components.navigation: Sticky header, backdrop-blur-md, high contrast text.
components.tables: Shadcn UI tables but heavily customized: transparent backgrounds, 1px subtle bottom borders, hover states on rows.
components.charts: Recharts with monotone lines/bars. Accentuated only with the primary coral color.
components.data_display: Huge typography for numbers (e.g., Stableford scores, Monthly Draw pools) using font-mono or tight tracking.
components.forms: Shadcn UI forms. Minimal borders, floating labels or clean top labels. Focus states must have an aggressive Coral ring.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle scale up (scale-105) for cards, slight border color lightening.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Framer motion staggered fade-in up (y: 20 -> 0) for bento grid children.
motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Implement smooth scrolling on the marketing pages.

media.rules: No placeholder images. Use the provided URLs strictly.

hero_background.description: Abstract dynamic 3D shapes on deep blue/dark backdrop for the hero or tech-focused sections.

charity_impact_1.description: Group of children. Use for the main charity mission section.

charity_impact_2.description: Lively event with children and volunteers. Use for 'Support Charities' blocks.

abstract_texture.description: Abstract wavy lines pattern. Use as an overlay or background texture for statistic cards.

dashboard_avatar.description: Smiling woman. Use as a placeholder for user avatars in the dashboard.

brand_logo.description: Modern minimalist logo symbol for the brand.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body. Update Google Fonts import in index.html or layout file.
Implement a dark theme using the precise hex codes provided in this guideline (Background: #09090B).
Marketing pages must utilize the 'Bento Grid' strategy for layout. Ensure overlapping text on images has a dark gradient overlay.
For the User and Admin Dashboards, use Shadcn components (tables, cards) but strip the heavy Vercel-like borders. Use the 'Flat Solid' surface strategy.
Strictly avoid any golf imagery (no grass, clubs, or balls). Focus on the tech platform, the subscription engine, and the human charity impact.
CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case, role-based) to facilitate robust automated testing.
